svg.metadata: {"id": "s017", "name": "游泳馆", "cat": "体育", "tags": ["体育", "游泳", "防溺水", "安全教育"], "desc": "室内标准泳池（8 道）：出发台、分道线、池底泳道标志线与 T 形端头、两条仰泳转身标志旗、秒表大钟、救生椅与浮板。", "stand": {"ground_y": 950, "x": [520, 1400]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "wall", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "windows", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.1, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "pace_clock", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.35, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "pool", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.1, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "caustics", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.6, "loop": "flow", "depth": null}, {"name": "lane_ropes", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.45, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "backstroke_flags", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.7, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}, {"name": "blocks", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.6, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "poolside", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.85, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "sparkle", "enter": "pop", "delay": 1.2, "loop": "twinkle", "depth": null}], "palette": {"wall1": "#EEF8FB", "wall2": "#D5EDF4", "tile": "#C3E3EC", "roof": "#FFFFFF", "roof2": "#C9DCE6", "win1": "#9FD9F5", "win2": "#EAF9FF", "deck": "#EAF2F4", "deck2": "#CFE0E6", "water1": "#7FD3EA", "water2": "#3BA9D3", "water3": "#2B8FBE", "laneline": "#1F5F8B", "rope1": "#E8473B", "rope2": "#FFFFFF", "rope3": "#2F7FC9", "rope4": "#F7C531", "block": "#FFFFFF", "block2": "#2F7FC9", "flag1": "#E8473B", "flag2": "#FFFFFF", "flag3": "#2F7FC9", "clock": "#FFFFFF", "clock2": "#2E3440", "ring": "#FF7A59", "chair": "#FFFFFF", "chair2": "#9AA8B3", "kick1": "#F7C531", "kick2": "#FF7A59", "kick3": "#5CCB7A", "shine": "#FFFFFF", "leaf": "#5FAE74", "leaf2": "#9ED38C", "pot": "#FFFFFF"}}
